rules: A brand follows its current owner. If the owner is untracked or unconfirmed, return no match (docs/BRAND_OWNERSHIP_2026-10-01.md).
The barcode owner decides the match, not the brand on the box.
prefixes[].action "add" ships the prefix for entityId in its space; it replaces any OFF-derived row with the same prefix.
prefixes[].action "block" removes an OFF-derived prefix from entityId.
prefixes[].space "upcA" matches only the 12-digit UPC-A of a scan; "ean13" matches only the 13-digit EAN-13.
products[].action "add" sets an exact barcode row (replacing any OFF row for that barcode); "block" removes one.
evidenceBar: Three or more distinct real barcodes with valid GS1 check digits share the prefix.

Two independent source families, or one official source (company site, FDA label, FDA GUDID). Open*Facts is one family; each retailer chain is one family; aggregators together are one family and never suffice alone.
Current ownership checked and dated; pending deals noted in pendingOwner.
No other company uses the prefix today. In shared GS1 US blocks (81, 84, 85, 86, 19) six digits is too short.
